title: manuscript-guard vault, on this machine
description: Where the vault's folder is on this machine. Written by `manuscript-guard vault init` at .manuscript-guard/vault.local.yaml, which `init` makes git ignore; it refuses to write it where git would track it. The hooks read it to know which folder a command must not name.

folder.description: The folder's absolute path as the person typed it at `vault init`: a mapped drive keeps its letter.

resolved.description: The same folder with its links followed, a mapped drive as its share. The hooks compare a command with both, and look neither up.
